outcome: rate of admission to the NICU
cohort: The study included 639 women with twin pregnancies, resulting in 1278 newborns.
finding: There were no significant differences in perinatal outcomes (newborns' weight, 5-minute Apgar score, arterial pH, NICU admission, or perinatal mortality) related to birth order or fetal presentation.
mod_finding: No evidence of poorer perinatal outcomes was found related to the mode of delivery.
